title: Deprecated Functionality: Gmagick::setcompressionquality(): Passing null to parameter #1 ($quality) of type int
body:
Hi. I could use a little help please as I can't print my pdfs when switched to GRAPHICSMAGICK.

I get this error:

Deprecated Functionality: Gmagick::setcompressionquality(): Passing null to parameter #1 ($quality) of type int is deprecated in /app/code/DevStone/ImageQuality/Image/Adapter/GraphicsMagick.php on line 152

Not sure what is happening. Magento 2.4.6
Php 8.2
Any help please much appreciated

Thanks
